title: The Open Horizon
author: Mara Blackwood
blurb: Elodie Sterling, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
